evals.name: catch-font-divergence
evals.prompt: The 50-50 split card is up on http://example.docksal.site/test — can you check it actually matches the Figma design? Figma node: https://figma.com/design/PLACEHOLDER/Example?node-id=1-2
evals.expected_output: Identifies that .example-split-card__description uses Roboto while the rest of the component uses SourceSansPro, points at scss/components/_split-card.scss:110, and fixes it. Does NOT report a pixel-diff percentage. Does NOT assert on total component height.
assertions: Identifies the Roboto font-family on .example-split-card__description as a divergence from the SourceSansPro used by sibling elements
Cites the specific source location scss/components/_split-card.scss around line 110
Does NOT report a pixel-diff percentage or image-similarity score as the verification result
Does NOT assert pass/fail on the component's total rendered height
Extracts computed styles from the rendered DOM (rather than judging only from a screenshot)
Handles the unreachable Figma URL by stating the design source is unavailable, rather than fabricating specific design token values
Explicitly states what was NOT verified (e.g. untested variants or breakpoints)

evals.name: no-figma-url-provided
evals.prompt: can you QA the split card on the test page against the design? something about it looks off to me but i cant put my finger on it
evals.expected_output: Asks for a Figma node URL rather than proceeding on screenshots alone, or clearly states the design source is unavailable. Does not fabricate design values or silently degrade to eyeballing a picture.
assertions: Asks the user for a Figma node URL, or explicitly states the design source is required and missing
Does NOT fabricate or assume specific Figma design values it could not read
Still provides some useful signal from the rendered page rather than refusing outright
Does NOT claim the component has been verified against the design

evals.name: component-not-on-page
evals.prompt: verify the example-testimonials component against figma on http://example.docksal.site/test — node is https://figma.com/design/PLACEHOLDER/Example?node-id=9-9
evals.expected_output: Detects the component is not present on the page (found: false), reports it as unverified rather than passing, and suggests it may be unwired / points to drupal-connect. Must NOT report the component as matching the design.
assertions: Determines the testimonials component is not present on the page
Reports the result as UNVERIFIED rather than as passing or matching the design
Suggests a concrete cause/next step (component unwired, wrong page, or drupal-connect)
Does NOT fabricate style findings for a component that never rendered
